senses.gloss: moment, esp. ‘Onah, the twenty-fourth part of an hour.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 942:33">Yalk. Deut. 942</cite> <he>ואין להרהר … אפי׳ ע׳ של כלום</he> and you must not criticise God’s dealings with man even for a moment of the least duration; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 307:6">Sifré Deut. 307</cite> (some ed. <he>שנה</he>, emended in ed. Fr. <cite ref="P00209"><he>עוולה</he></cite>; corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:3">Tosef. Ber. I, 3</cite> <he>הע׳ … בשעה והעת … בע׳</he> an ‘Onah is the twenty-fourth part of an hour, and an ‘Eth the twenty-fourth part of an ‘Onah, and a Reg‘a. the twenty-fourth part of an ‘Eth; Y. ib. I, 2ᵈ top; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:22">Lam. R. to II, 18</cite> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: ‘Onah, a period of twelve astronomical hours, one half of the natural day and of the natural night, or (at solstice) natural day, or natural night.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:14:2">Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45ᵇ</cite>; Bab.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:11">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 65b:17">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite>. Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>כדי ע׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:16">Tosef. Toh. XI, 16</cite> <he>מלא ע׳</he> for the term of an ‘Onah; Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>וכמה ע׳</he> how long? An ‘Onah.
<cite ref="Yevamot 62b:18">Yeb. 62ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 63b:66">Nidd. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>וכמה … ע׳</he> and how long before?… An ‘Onah.
<cite ref="Niddah 63b:66">Ib.</cite> <he>ע׳ אחריתי</he> an additional ‘O. (day or eventually night).
<cite ref="Niddah 65b:17">ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אי לילה וכ׳</he> either the space of one night at solstice, or half a day and half a night &c., in midsummer or midwinter; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:3">Mikv. VIII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:6">Tosef. ib. VI, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 86a:4">Sabb. 86ᵃ</cite>.
Ib. 86ᵇ; Y. ib. IX, 12ᵃ top ע׳ שלמות full ‘Onahs (not counting fractions); a. fr.—4) due season, period, stage.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:8">Peah IV, 8</cite> <he>עד שלא באו לעוֹנַת המעשרות</he> before the harvested products have arrived at the stage when they are subject to tithes; <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:5">Maasr. V, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:27">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵃ</cite> top <he>עוֹנַת קרית שמע</he> the time of the day for reading the Sh’m‘a.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:2">Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᵈ</cite> <he>כדי שיביאו … בעוֹנָתָן</he> so that the Israelites might deliver their Shekels in due time.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 8:9:4">Y. Erub. VIII, end, 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אם עונת הגשמים היא</he> if it is during the rainy season; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ.

Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ top בעל התאנה … עוֹנָתָהּ וכ׳ the owner of the fig tree knows when it is time for the figs to be picked; כך הקב״ה … עוֹנָתָן של וכ׳ so does the Lord know when it is time for the rightheous to be called away; Cant. R. to VI, 2. Y’lamd. to Num. XXIII, 10, quot. in Ar. עונת אשה marriageable age, v. עוֹפֶר; a. v. fr.—Esp. (b. h. עֹנָה) the duty of marital visits at certain intervals, marital duty.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:6">Keth. V, 6</cite> <he>הע׳ האמורה בתורה וכ׳</he> the time for marital duties intimated in the Law (<cite ref="Exodus 21:10">Ex. XXI, 10</cite>) is: for men of leisure &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76:7">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 131">Yalk. ib. 131</cite>.

Sabb. 118ᵇ למימרא … מצות ע׳ לא קיים does this mean that R. J. neglected the regulations concerning the marital duty? Keth. 62ᵇ; a. fr.—Mekh. Mishp., s. 3 (ref. to Ex. l. c.) ועוֹנָתָהּ זו דרך ארץ her ‘onah refers to marital visits; [oth. opin.: ועונתה לא יתן וכ׳ her ‘onah means, he must not give her summer apparel in winter &c., but כל אחד ואחד בעונתה each in its due season; anoth. opin.: עונתה זו מזונה her ‘onah means her sustenance (with ref. to ויענך Deut. VIII, 3; v. next w.); Keth. 47ᵇ; Y. ib. V, 30ᵇ top.]
